briefdescription.para: Samples the stacks of the processes that the scout process starts, while a command runs.

detaileddescription.para: The constructor starts a kernel sampling session and a thread that reads its records. The sampler counts, for each table type, how many samples hold each frame. The two table types are sample for the timer samples and cswitch for the context switches. The drain function stops the session and the thread. The getSamples function then returns the counts as a tree. Only the descendants of the scout process contribute samples.
